title: Is Anyone Enforcing the Cartel? What Reinforcement Learning Teaches LLM Agents in Markets
abstract: arXiv:2610.28787v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Evaluations of large language model (LLM) agents report that pricing agents collude at others' expense. Yet collusion is defined by enforcement: a cartel, in which competitors share monopoly profits, holds only if a member who cheats is punished. We introduce an audit that tests enforcement by forcing a member to cheat in counterfactual copies of a market, and use it to study what reinforcement learning (RL) teaches agents in pricing and trading. Small LLMs trained by RL learn what their training rivals reward, but only what they readily try. In self-play, they learn fixed rules ignoring their rivals; against a punishing rival, to be deterred; against a cheating rival, to match its cuts, never the costly price war that would deter it, which they rarely try. A war forced into training is learned, but mostly only where it was forced. Against their own copies, deterred and matching agents can earn the same cartel profits, but only matching

translated_title: 有人在执行卡特尔吗？强化学习教会了市场中的LLM智能体什么
translated_abstract: 对大型语言模型（LLM）智能体的评估报告称，定价智能体会以牺牲他人利益为代价进行合谋。然而，合谋的定义核心在于执行机制：一个由竞争者分享垄断利润的卡特尔，只有当作弊的成员受到惩罚时才能维持。我们引入了一种审计方法，通过在市场的反事实副本中强制某个成员作弊来检验执行机制，并用它来研究强化学习（RL）教会了定价与交易中的智能体什么。经RL训练的小型LLM学到的是其训练对手所奖励的行为，但仅限于它们容易尝试的行为。在自我对弈中，它们学会的是无视对手的固定规则；面对会施以惩罚的对手，它们学会被威慑；面对作弊的对手，它们学会跟随其降价，却永远学不会那种本可威慑作弊者的高昂代价的价格战——而这种策略它们很少尝试。被强制加入训练中的价格战能够被学会，但大多只在被迫使用的情境下才生效。面对自身的副本时，被威慑的和跟随降价的智能体都能获得相同的卡特尔利润，但只有跟随降价……（原文摘要到此截断）
tldr: 该研究提出一种在反事实市场副本中强制智能体作弊以检验合谋执行机制的审计方法，发现RL训练的LLM定价智能体只会学会训练中易尝试且被奖励的行为（被威慑或跟随降价），而无法自发掌握执行卡特尔所必需的高代价价格战惩罚。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces an audit that forces an agent to cheat in counterfactual copies of a market to test cartel enforcement, revealing that RL-trained LLM pricing agents only learn behaviors that are rewarded and readily attempted—being deterred or matching price cuts—and never spontaneously acquire the costly price war needed to enforce a cartel.
